about.description: I’m Mikael Ribeiro Silvestre de Azevedo, a Software Developer with experience building and evolving back-end, front-end, and UI/UX solutions. I work with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Angular, TypeScript, PHP, React.js, and relational databases, contributing to different stages of development: understanding needs, implementation, integration, bug fixing, and maintenance. I enjoy turning business problems into clear, functional, and well-structured solutions while applying good practices, writing maintainable code, and continuously improving my technical skills. I’m currently studying Computer Science and aiming to grow as a Full-Stack Developer, focusing on Java and Angular.
